authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5082 jaṅghā explicitly gives Assamese zāṅ leg, Bengali jāṅ/jāṅi thigh/leg and northwestern jaṅ/jaṅg leg forms. Bishnupriya jaŋ and Kullui dʒəŋ elicited foot are linked to this lower-limb family with the foot-versus-leg semantic range explicitly qualified; no source gloss is changed or exact anatomical boundary inferred. Consonant simplification and vowels remain as transcribed; local Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Exact response: jaŋ.
